config.description: School-wide lines every generation prompt receives. Neha and Achal own the wording.
value: Each item tests exactly one idea. No tricks and no trap wording.
Word problems use things a child in Pune knows: mangoes, rupees, cricket runs, school steps, the mela, the bus.
One short plain sentence for a word problem, with both numbers in it and one question at the end.
A child who has the skill should finish any item in under a minute.

config.description: Who may sign in to the app, by school email. Roles: coordinator, educator, specialist.
The difficulty a child starts at when their own evidence is not enough yet, per band. The teacher's declaration chooses the skill set; this chooses how hard it is.
Questions on one worksheet. Twelve fills two sides for Grade 2 and 3.
Unnamed extra copies printed at each difficulty, for a child who spoils a page or arrives late.
Tried in order after the prompt row's own model. Haiku is the cheap Anthropic fallback; the Gemini free tier is the last resort (20 requests per model per day).

INR per million tokens, in and out, at roughly ₹88/USD. Sonnet 5 matches Anthropic's published rate; Haiku 4.5 is an estimate pending a verified figure at anthropic.com/pricing — correct this row when one is confirmed, nothing else changes. Gemini's free-tier flash models cost nothing until the daily quota is exhausted, so 0/0 here is the pilot's honest number, not a placeholder. A model missing from this table prices at 0 — the adapter still runs it, budget tracking just can't see it, which is why every model actually in use belongs here.
